say:1:1422623001:0.text: Let me go! I'm not going to serve you any longer! I'm free!
say:1:1422623001:0.source_cn: 放开我！我才不要继续伺候你了！我已经自由了！

say:2:1422623002:0.text: Need I remind you that it was my gracious decision to elevate you to my service? Were it not for my generosity, you'd never have set foot in the royal city. And now you dare think of leaving? Guards! Seize this insolent wretch at once!
say:2:1422623002:0.source_cn: 是我选了你当仆从，不然你能来王城？你不准走！喂，卫兵！...

say:3:1422623003:1.text: Calm down, both of you. Yelling won't solve anything.
say:3:1422623003:1.source_cn: 二位，都冷静下，不要在街上拉拉扯扯大喊大叫的。

say:4:1422623004:2.text: Former lord or not, the rules are plain. Everyone's equal in Sal'thorin now. Servants can choose to leave. Best accept it before you embarrass yourself.
say:4:1422623004:2.source_cn: 这位前贵族老爷，情况已经变了，仆从们可以自由选择离开。...

say:5:1422623005:0.text: Yes, I have accepted it! Being a man of honor, I complied with the new decree. I even went above and beyond, drafting a proper contract for her domestic service. And, unlike others, I had the decency to pay her wages in advance!
say:5:1422623005:0.source_cn: 我改变了啊！律法变了之后，我就与她签了家政服务的合约！...

say:6:1422623006:0.text: Yet after barely two days, this insolent wretch dares to flee! The contract is clear! If she breaks it, she must face penalties! I demand restitution!
say:6:1422623006:0.source_cn: 现在才干了两天她就要违约逃跑！至少要给违约金吧！

say:7:1422623007:2.text: Oh... Madam, is everything he said true?
say:7:1422623007:2.source_cn: 那……这位女士，请问这位前老爷说的……

say:8:1422623008:0.text: Before the law changed, I was under his thumb for years! This is just compensation for all that time I worked for free! Besides, his contract was unreasonable! I don't accept it!
say:8:1422623008:0.source_cn: 他奴役了我这么久，这只是正常给我的赔偿金！况且他那份合...

say:9:1422623009:0.text: They say you can actually make a living up on the surface now! You really think after surviving this dirt hole, I won't find work topside?!
say:9:1422623009:0.source_cn: 听说现在可以去地表上讨生活了，我就不信离开这个鬼地方，...

say:10:1422623010:0.text: At least finish cleaning my house first!
say:10:1422623010:0.source_cn: 但你至少帮我把家里打扫完了再说啊！

say:11:1422623011:0.text:
Okay, calm down.
Madam, has your curse been lifted?
say:11:1422623011:0.source_cn: 冷静，冷静。\n女士，你的诅咒解除了吗？

say:12:1422623012:1.text: What are you talking about? I'm cursed?
say:12:1422623012:1.source_cn: 那是什么？我怎么还有诅咒？

say:13:1422623013:1.text: It seems you haven't read the announcement on the notice board...
say:13:1422623013:1.source_cn: 看来，之前张贴和宣读的告示你是一点都不知道啊……

choice_prompt:14:1422623013.text: It seems you haven't read the announcement on the notice board...
choice_prompt:14:1422623013.source_cn: 看来，之前张贴和宣读的告示你是一点都不知道啊……

say:15:1422623014:2.text: Ha! It's good to see you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1422623014:2.male: Ha! It's good to see you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1422623014:2.female: Ha! It's good to see you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:16:1422623015:0.text: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.
say:16:1422623015:0.source_cn: 你作为当事人之一，一定很有说服力。
say:16:1422623015:0.male: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.
say:16:1422623015:0.female: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.

choice_prompt:17:1422623015.text: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.
choice_prompt:17:1422623015.source_cn: 你作为当事人之一，一定很有说服力。
choice_prompt:17:1422623015.male: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.
choice_prompt:17:1422623015.female: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.

say:18:1422623016:1.text: Yes, if you go to the surface without having your curse removed, you'll be corrupted.
say:18:1422623016:1.source_cn: 没错，你们没有解除诅咒就贸然前往地面，可能会直接孽化。

say:19:1422623017:1.text: That's horrible... Let me reconsider everything then.
say:19:1422623017:1.source_cn: 这……这也太吓人了，我、我再好好想想！

say:20:1422623018:1.text: You can reconsider things while cleaning!
say:20:1422623018:1.source_cn: 可以边干活边想，先回我家！

say:21:1422623019:0.text: Get out of my face! I ain't working for you ever again!
say:21:1422623019:0.source_cn: 去你的吧！别想再让我给你工作了！

say:24:1422623020:0.text: Hey! Don't go! Come back! We're not done talking!
say:24:1422623020:0.source_cn: 诶！别、别走啊……我们事情还没说……完呢……

say:25:1422623021:2.text: Alright, calm down. She won't be leaving Sal'thorin any time soon. You go home and wait. We'll try mediating and see if she wants to work for you again.
say:25:1422623021:2.source_cn: 行了行了，短时间内她应该不会离开萨洛克兰，你先回家等消...

say:26:1422623022:2.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although it's great to see you, why the sudden visit?
say:26:1422623022:2.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although it's great to see you, why the sudden visit?
say:26:1422623022:2.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although it's great to see you, why the sudden visit?

choice_prompt:27:1422623022.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although it's great to see you, why the sudden visit?
choice_prompt:27:1422623022.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although it's great to see you, why the sudden visit?

say:28:1422623023:1.text: Well, the captain should be in the square at this time. You should check if he's still there.
say:28:1422623023:1.source_cn: 唔，卫队长应该在广场，你去那里看看吧。
say:28:1422623023:1.male: Well, the captain should be in the square at this time. You should check if he's still there.
say:28:1422623023:1.female: Well, the captain should be in the square at this time. You should check if he's still there.

choice:27:0:1.text: I came to talk to Indris.
choice:27:0:1.male: I came to talk to Indris.
choice:27:0:1.female: I came to talk to Indris.

choice:17:0:1.text: So the curse on your people...
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: （向这些人解释诅咒和诅咒的后果）
choice:17:0:1.male: So the curse on your people...
choice:17:0:1.female: So the curse on your people...

choice:14:0:1.text: I can explain if you want.
choice:14:0:1.male: I can explain if you want.
choice:14:0:1.female: I can explain if you want.
